title: Best OP Instant Steal Auto Hatch Auto Place Auto Rebirth
features:
Ronix Hub - Clone to Steal an Egg

Instant Steal
- Auto instant steal, teleports onto the nearest egg that passes your filters and grabs it
- Takes you back to the safezone after every steal, walking or by instant teleport
- Steal delay (0.01-1 s)
- Speed boost while you carry an egg, walk speed (16-80)
- Teleport to Safezone button
- Fix Stuck Prompts button

Egg Filters
- Area filter, 14 areas from Starter to Rift, refreshed from the game's own area list
- Rarity filter with all 25 tiers, Common up to SPECIAL
- One click for Secret and up
- Mutation filter, Normal, Gold, Diamond, Radioactive and Rainbow
- Size filter, Baby, Big and Huge, with Huge only and Huge plus Big presets

Egg Farm
- Auto place eggs from your backpack and inventory onto your plot
- Place everything, or only by rarity, egg name or size, all 26 eggs listed
- Place delay (0.5-5 s) and a Place Now button
- Auto hatch, opens your placed eggs as soon as their timer is done
- Hatch everything, or only by rarity, egg name or size
- Hatch check delay (0.2-3 s) and a Hatch Now button

Pets and Progress
- Auto equip best pets, every few seconds and straight after a hatch
- Auto upgrade animal slots
- Auto rebirth, fires the moment your cash covers the next rebirth
- Auto claim the free shop reward and the training speed bonus
- Auto buy the train tools and trails you can afford, then equip the best one

Inventory
- Auto sell all inventory
- Auto use Luck, Cash and Train potions
- Sell, Rebirth, Equip Best and Upgrade Slot buttons for a one time run

Misc
- Anti AFK, on by default

Mobile friendly. Join discord.gg/ronixstudios for support and updates.
